chapter.verse: Ta pil in a pa’ hilhna mang a, a kihisak mi in akhial min pua nuam lo hi.
Mihoihte in a kamsiamna bangun thaman sang a, mizuaute in siattat ding bek ut uh hi.
Pau a ki-ip zo mi in a nuntakna a hu hi a, a mawk paupau mi in amah a kisiasak tawm ahi hi.
Thadah mi in a deih ngah zo lo a, nasep hahkat mi in a deih khempeuh ngah zo hi.
Thuman mi in zuauthu deih lo a, a gilo mi in gensiatna leh mindai nading bek pau hi.
Diktatna in midikte hu a, gitlohna in mawhneite’ pukna hi.
Mi pawlkhatte, zawng napi-in kihau sak uh a, mi pawlkhatte, hau napi-in kizawngsak uh hi.
Mihaupa’ sum hauhna in a nuntakna tankhia zo a, mizawngpa in kitat nading bangmah nei lo hi.
Thuman mite, khuavak bangin taang lela a, migilote meivak bangin mit pak hi.
Hilh ding ut lo a, kihihsakna in kitotna bek piangsak thei a, hong kithuhilh ding utna in a hoihzaw ahi hi.
Ol tak-a hauh pakna in kiam kik pah a, haksapi-a hauh tohna in khang semsem hi.
Lamet tun’lohna in lungsim cinasak a, deihna tangtun’na in lungdamna hi.
Thu kihilh ding ut lohna in siat ding utna hi a, thu kihilhna zuihna in lungnopna hi.
Mipilte’ thuhilhna in nuntakna tuinak bang hi a, sihna thang tawh kipelhna ahi hi.
Thu ngaihsut theihna in maipha ngahna hi a, zuautatna in lungkhamna bek piangsak hi.
Thu ngaihsun theite, pilna tawh gamta a, mihaite in a haina tangkoko hi.
Kamtai ginalo in mi lungkhamsak a, a citak thu puapa in mi lungdam kik sak hi.
Thu kihilhna zui lo mi in zawn’na leh mindaina ngah a, thu kihilhna a zui mi in minphatna leh pahtawina ngah hi.
Deihna ngahna in lungsim nuam sak a, siat gamtatna panin mihaite pialkhia nuam lo hi.
Mipil tawh kikhawl lecin na pil ding a, mihai tawh kikhawl lecin gimna na thuak ding hi.
Tuahsiatna in mawhneite sulzuih kawikawi a, midikte tuahpha kawikawi hi.
Midikte in a tu a tate’ luah ding gamh nei a, mawhneite neihsate ahih leh midikte’ ading hi lel hi.
Lo thak panin mizawngte’ khamkhop ding an piang kha ding a, ahi zongin thuman lohna hangin tua nangawn maimang thei ding hi.
A ta a tai nuam lote in a mudah hi a, a ta a itte in lim takin thuhilhin tai hi.
Thuman mi in a kham ding nei-in a gil vah a, a gilo mi in nektawm ding nei loin a gil kial hi.
